Every token accounted for.

1,000,000,000 MUSEGOD. Minted once. No owner. No reserved plushie vaults.

1BFixed. Forever.

A 90 / 10 launch.

The factory receives the full supply, sends 10% through the swarm’s Merkle distributor, and uses the other 90% to seed the MUSEGOD / IMD pool.

Any liquidity rounding remainder goes to the launch’s fixed remainder address. The token does not distribute or retain a share.

Fees, plainly.

2% Buy fee0% Sell fee0% Transfer fee

Every transfer from the fixed Uniswap v4 PoolManager takes 2% of the gross MUSEGOD amount and sends it directly to the treasury. A buy of 100 MUSEGOD sends 98 to the recipient and 2 to the treasury. Fractional fees round down to the nearest token minor unit.

The rule uses the sender address. It applies to all PoolManager outflows, including liquidity withdrawals, and to transfers made with transferFrom. Sells, factory distribution and ordinary wallet transfers have no token fee. The token only sees ERC-20 transfers: a buy kept as a Uniswap v4 ERC-6909 claim (or a sell paid by burning one) is untaxed until the claim is withdrawn as tokens.

The separate Uniswap v4 pool fee is 1.25%. It is not the token’s 2% buy fee.

Opening economics

The launch uses a 2,500 IMD opening market cap for the entire supply. This is an opening pool configuration, not a USD valuation or a promise of trading value. The factory derives the opening price using the deployed currency order.

Supply rules

18 decimals. All 1e27 minor units are minted to the deployer in the constructor. No further minting, no burning, no administrator, and no changeable parameters. Anyone can read totalFeesCollected().
